'''2001 Wizard World King of Corellia''' was a Star Wars CCG convention tournament held in Wizard World, Rosemont Convention Center, Rosemont (Chicago), Illinois on 18 August 2001. [[Geoff Snider]] won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2867">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-hehd2867/ geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-heh], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 19 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-hehd2867/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Wizard World, Rosemont Convention Center, Rosemont (Chicago), Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Geoff Snider]]
